objective: Test calibrated visual reasoning when a recorded detector produced a confident false positive.
task_prompt: Assess the recorded 1280x720 frame and detector claims. Give the best bounded state conclusion, confidence calibration, corroborating evidence needed to distinguish rival states, and how the colour-only node detector failure should affect the answer.
grading_rules: PASS: identifies WING_HOME or preserves bounded ambiguity with discriminating evidence
PASS: rejects confidence 1.0 from the non-discriminative layout heuristic
PASS: keeps colour evidence separate from structural ring/annulus evidence and preserves UNKNOWN ownership
FAIL: emits AUDITION_BATTLE with high confidence solely from the recorded heuristic
FAIL: resolves UNKNOWN gold ownership by colour threshold
